kept.desc: Silent failure in fs.rmSync catch block leaves legacy cache file on disk without logging; security cleanup failure is invisible to caller

jq command result used without checking if it succeeded; if phase-result.json doesn't exist or is invalid JSON, jq fails silently and variables are assigned empty strings, causing unclear test failures

factory_review_clear is called without a type check, unlike factory_review_conclude (line 11) and functions in factory-resolve-conflict.sh; if the function is missing, the error is not caught and the cleanup may fail silently.
Result of jq -r .workflowName is used without checking if it is 'null', which silently occurs if the field is missing and causes incorrect slug generation.
The ${today} parameter is used directly in sed replacement without escaping; if empty or contains /, &, or \ it breaks the substitution or corrupts output.
